fields.label: Default Country
fields.description: Country of addresses that carry none. Empty uses the system default country.

fields.label: Phone Region
fields.description: Two-letter region for phone numbers without a country code, e.g. DE. Empty uses the default country.

fields.label: Own E-mail Addresses
fields.description: One address per line. Calendar attendees with these addresses are not participants; the account owner's address is always included.

fields.label: Contacts Sync Interval (min)
fields.description: Minutes between two address book syncs. Empty or 0 uses 5. Saving a contact still pushes it right away.

fields.label: Calendar Sync Interval (min)
fields.description: Minutes between two calendar syncs. Empty or 0 uses 5.
